VAGUE_LINK_TEXT.title: Meaningful Link Text
VAGUE_LINK_TEXT.description: Hyperlink text must clearly describe the purpose or destination of the link.

NO_LANGUAGE_OPTION.title: Language Selection
NO_LANGUAGE_OPTION.description: Websites catering to multilingual citizens must provide clear language switching mechanisms.

LOW_CONTRAST.title: Contrast Ratio
LOW_CONTRAST.description: Visual presentation of text and images of text must have a minimum contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1.

NEW_WINDOW_UNANNOUNCED.title: New Window Warning
NEW_WINDOW_UNANNOUNCED.description: Users must be warned in advance when a link opens in a new browser window or tab.
